purpose: Test whether native Cosmos3-Nano responds causally and reliably to frozen DROID-compatible policy actions across independent sessions before any full-episode ranking spend.

inputs.window_selection: three highest-translation first chunks from distinct real policies within each session, with action-only rotation and gripper tie-breakers
inputs.initial_observation: recorded frame zero from the same session and policy as each active action chunk
inputs.cross_rate_mapping: none; every selected action window and initial observation starts at index zero
inputs.task_prompt: single ASCII space, matching the official label-free DROID forward-dynamics example and avoiding task metadata access

action_contract.rotation: valid rot6d derived from backward framewise SE3 delta
action_contract.gripper: explicit observation-bound hold for no-motion; dataset-version flip for recorded actions
action_contract.normalization_basis: official current Cosmos DROID forward-dynamics config sets action_normalization=None and the pinned vLLM helper pads but does not normalize external tensors
action_contract.view_contract: wrist full-width top; exterior 1 half-width bottom-left; exterior 2 half-width bottom-right

controls.policy_swapped: real distinct policy trace from the same session
controls.shifted: same real policy trace beginning one action step later while retaining frame-zero observation

execution.request_count_derivation: 17 sessions x 3 windows x 6 conditions x 2 seeds

frozen_rollout_reliability_thresholds.threshold_anchor: campaign-3 development clips plus real DROID reference; frozen here before new generated output

frozen_causal_gates.cross_seed_noise_definition: maximum of recorded seed0-versus-seed1 and zero seed0-versus-seed1 scene-masked distance

decision_rule.pass: native Cosmos may advance to complete replay/full-episode ranking diagnostics at the same-snapshot claim ceiling
decision_rule.fail_with_complete_powered_matrix: native Cosmos is not qualified for this frozen DROID stack; Blueprint must abstain
